agent_explanation: With no walls, controller off and work=0, the only energy change can come from the arena ceiling bounce at step 625->626. Incoming vy ~+14.99 becomes vy ~-35.08 despite e=0.7 (expected ~-10.5), injecting ~500 J. Setting e=0 still rebounds at ~-24.6 instead of ~0, so restitution is not the cause; the ceiling contact impulse/positional correction itself adds energy (wrong sign or correction counted as velocity).
